name: cache-keeper
description: Keeps the main conversation's prompt cache warm while you are away, within a window you choose, and shows its state above the prompt.

keepFor.title: Keep the cache warm for
keepFor.description: How long the cache is kept warm after your last message, once you turn warming on (every session starts off).

lead.title: Refresh this many minutes before expiry
lead.description: Applies to the 1-hour cache; the 5-minute cache is refreshed 30 seconds before expiry.

minTokens.title: Skip contexts smaller than
minTokens.description: Tokens in the prompt below which refreshing costs more than rewriting would.

weeklyGuard.title: Stop at weekly usage %
weeklyGuard.description: Warming stops once your weekly plan usage reaches this percent.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: full shows state, savings and buttons; minimal a short line; off hides it.

upgradeTo1h.title: Use the 1-hour cache on API-key sessions
upgradeTo1h.description: Sets CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL=1h for this process when the 5-minute cache would otherwise apply.
